body: Closes two of Sprint 3's own named gaps. fetchCharacterCombatStats calls idunaClient.GetCharacter on PacketConnect (WAR/level 1 fallback if IDUNA has no character row, not a hard reject), computes starting HP via jobpkg.HPAtLevel -- same formula apps2/mud already uses. clientInfo gained real jobMain/level/hp/maxHP. PacketWSCast now actually subtracts damage from the target's real HP and reports target_hp/target_max_hp/killed, instead of just reporting a number. 1 new test verified deterministically against an unreachable IDUNA URL. go build/test clean. Commit e553860.
title: apps2/server-go gets real IDUNA job fetch + real HP tracking
